say:1:1013702001:1.text: Hold on. I hear something up ahead...
say:1:1013702001:1.source_cn: 等等，停一下。听，前面有声音……

say:3:1013702002:1.text: Well done. Being alert is a strong trait. We meet again, my worthy opponent.
say:3:1013702002:1.source_cn: 呵，不错，保持警觉是强者的修养。又见到你们了，我的对手。

say:4:1013702003:1.text: You keep showing up in front of me. Do you miss sparring with me? How thrilling!
say:4:1013702003:1.source_cn: 你不断出现在我面前，是在怀念与我切磋的感觉吗？真是热血...
say:4:1013702003:1.male: You keep showing up in front of me. Do you miss sparring with me? How thrilling!
say:4:1013702003:1.female: You keep showing up in front of me. Do you miss sparring with me? How thrilling!

say:5:1013702004:1.text: Come to my camp. Let's have another competition of strength!
say:5:1013702004:1.source_cn: 我几乎能感受到你的魔咒勒紧我咽喉的感觉，去我的营地再战...
say:5:1013702004:1.male: Come to my camp. Let's have another competition of strength!
say:5:1013702004:1.female: Come to my camp. Let's have another competition of strength!

say:7:1013702005:1.text: This guy is so weird... It's you who keeps popping up in front of us!
say:7:1013702005:1.source_cn: 这家伙好不讲道理……明明是你不断出现在我们面前好不好！

say:8:1013702006:1.text: I have a feeling that what you're seeking might be found with me.
say:8:1013702006:1.source_cn: 我有一种预感，你们所追寻的东西能在我那里获得启示。
